{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Jenna''. You become more ''incandescent'' every time we meet. I was so ''sorry'' to hear about your father.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Sorry''? It was one of ''your'' thugs that ''killed'' him.|Bo-Dum and Jenna|<ref name="TCK" />}}
The '''father''' of [[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Jenna's [[Parent/Legends|father]] was the [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian settlement|settlement]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. He was killed by one of the thugs of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bo-Dum]], leaving the settlers without a lawman to protect them.
